cohort: A cohort of 109 preterm neonates born at <32 weeks gestational age (median 26.9 weeks) without known congenital anomalies of the kidney.
finding: The study found a consistent decrease in RrSO2 by 20 points during the first 60 hours of life, followed by stabilization, and that RrSO2 baseline trends increased by 2.1 percentage points for each additional week of gestational age between 24 and 32 weeks.
gest_age: <32 weeks gestational age (median 26.9 weeks, range 24-32 weeks)
